d.ko: Explore, talk, and solve puzzles with cards in a solo tabletop adventure! Play as Alice, a girl trapped in the Beyond. Drag cards to craft items, meet curious companions, and find your way home. Stuck? Try a different card—and a different approach. This charming fairy-tale world has its secrets.

d.zh: 一场用卡牌探索、交涉与解谜的单人跑团冒险！扮演困在彼岸的少女爱丽丝，拖动手中的卡牌，探索童话小镇、合成道具，与性格各异的同伴一起寻找回家的路。遇到麻烦？试试换张牌，换个办法。但要小心，这个可爱的世界也藏着不安的秘密。
